title: Proxy and Surrogate (2018)
headline: No defect was found in either theorem within the stated scope. This is not a proof that they are correct.

claims.label: Theorem 1
claims.gist: Nested seniority classes guarantee a fair, strategy-proof assignment.
claims.statement: If seniority classes are nested, there is an assignment rule that is fair to seniority and strategy-proof for workers.

result.summary: A fair, strategy-proof rule found for every structure checked.
result.search_scope: Every nested structure over up to five shifts; rules constructed by the paper's algorithm and checked exhaustively.
result.limits: Larger structures rest on the constructive proof.

vor_check.detail: Statement and definitions checked on rendered pages; the proof compared in extracted text only.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.label: Theorem 3
claims.gist: Without nesting, some preference profile defeats every such rule.
claims.statement: If seniority classes are not nested, some preference profile admits no assignment rule that is fair and strategy-proof.

result.summary: A defeating profile found for every non-nested structure checked.
result.search_scope: Every non-nested structure over up to four shifts.
result.limits: Structures over five or more shifts rest on the proof.

vor_check.detail: Statement and definitions checked on rendered pages; the proof compared in extracted text only.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).
